requirements.note: All 260 tickers listed with symbol, name, $price and signed % change in green/red; disclosure chevron per row.

Prices tick about once a second in place, including during scrolling. With price/change sort the rows re-sort live, so they shuffle under the finger; in one mid-fling frame a row was caught squashed with its % clipped.

Native pull-down sort menu (Symbol A–Z, Price high–low, Change high–low) with checkmark; no direction toggle. Search matches symbol and name ("bio" gives 25, "zexo" gives 1) and has a No Results empty state.
Blue star per row toggles fill; native segmented control All / My List filters correctly with count.
Detail shows name, large price, % since open, Open, Volume and a line chart that grows to 60 samples live with low/high labels.
My List and sort (also the All/My List scope) restored after relaunch.

bugs: The bottom search field does not rise above the keyboard: once focused it stays hidden behind the keyboard, so the query being typed is not visible.
In one mid-fling frame a row was caught squashed with its change text clipped while live re-sorting animated rows.
tells: No large title on the main screen; a small inline 'Watchlist' title only.
Rows have no swipe actions; a horizontal swipe on a row just opens the detail screen.
Row has both a chevron and a trailing star button, which is a slightly crowded, non-standard row layout.
Detail star button in the nav bar is black rather than tinted, which doesn't match the blue stars in the list.
A.scroll: Whole-screen list with native momentum, bounce and scroll-edge blur under the bar; smooth, though rows re-sort live under the finger when sorted by price or change.

requirements.note: All 260 tickers with symbol, name, price (no currency sign) and % change with up/down arrow glyph in green/red.
Prices update about once a second in place, including while scrolling; rows re-sort live under price/change sort.
Native menu: Symbol / Price / Change plus a direction toggle (Z to A); search matches symbol and name.
Leading star per row toggles; custom green-tinted segmented control All / My List filters, with 'N companies saved' count.
Detail shows price, % and $ change since open, open, volume, a 60-second area chart with gridlines and LIVE badge updating live, and an Add/Remove button.
My List and sort (with direction) restored after relaunch.

bugs: When the search field is focused it slides up and gets clipped under the navigation bar: the field and its typed text are almost entirely hidden (only its bottom edge shows), and the sort button/count disappear.
The list is a fixed-height table under a non-scrolling header (title, tagline, search, segmented control, sort): only about 6 rows are visible, and at the largest text size only about 1.5.
tells: Header area doesn't scroll away with the list, unlike a native large-title list; the large title never collapses on scroll.
Segmented control is restyled with a solid green selected pill and its taller metrics are non-standard.
Custom search capsule placed in content rather than a system search bar in the navigation bar.
Rows have no swipe actions; a horizontal swipe opens the detail screen.
Leading star in the row's leading position and no disclosure chevron; marketing-style tagline 'A little perspective. Every second.'
Detail screen is a bespoke card layout (custom chart card, full-width 'In My List' button) rather than an inset grouped list.
B.scroll: Momentum and bounce feel native, but the scrolling area is a small window under a fixed header, so flings move through few rows and the page feels cramped; rows also re-sort live.

why: Both meet every requirement, and in both the search text is hidden while typing (A's field stays behind the keyboard, B's is clipped under the nav bar). A's full-screen list, stock segmented control and inset grouped detail screen read much more like a stock iOS app. B's fixed header leaves only a small scrolling window for the list, which is cramped at normal text and nearly unusable at the largest size, even though its chart is richer.
